title: Official PDC Darts Walk-On Songs & Anthems Directory
source: PDC Official Tournament Walk-On Records & Broadcaster Cue Sheets
walk_on_culture: In professional darts, walk-on music is an essential component of the event theater. Escorted by PDC security down the walk-on ramp into the Great Hall, each player's chosen anthem sets their psychological tone and establishes an intimate connection with the 3,000+ chanting fans.

songs.artist: Pitbull ft. Flo Rida & LunchMoney Lewis
songs.crowd_reaction: High energy synchronized clapping and jumping, popular with younger fans and festival crowds.
songs.walk_on_history: Adopted during his record-breaking junior career and maintained throughout his historic 2024 World Championship debut run.

songs.crowd_reaction: Thunderous chorus singalong accompanied by air guitar playing and bouncing in the tables.
songs.walk_on_history: Chosen because of Humphries' passionate support for Leeds United FC, where Kaiser Chiefs' anthem is an Elland Road staple.

songs.crowd_reaction: The most famous chant in darts history, with arenas singing 'Oh, Michael van Gerwen!' to the bass riff.
songs.walk_on_history: Adopted early in his PDC career, becoming synonymous with his dominant multi-world championship era.

songs.crowd_reaction: Instantly recognizable baseline leading to roaring applause and Price's trademark bicep flexes on stage.
songs.walk_on_history: Custom-fitted to his 'Iceman' persona since his professional crossover from Welsh rugby.

songs.crowd_reaction: Joyful, feel-good atmosphere with fans dancing across both the tables and tiered seating.
songs.walk_on_history: Propelled him through his 2022 Grand Slam and 2023 World Championship triumphs.

songs.crowd_reaction: The ultimate party spectacle as Wright sidesteps and dances across the stage wings from left to right.
songs.walk_on_history: One of the longest-running, most beloved walk-on rituals in the history of the sport.

songs.crowd_reaction: Mass arena movement as thousands of spectators literally jump around to the frantic horn blast and beat.
songs.walk_on_history: Has accompanied Anderson through all five of his World Championship finals and both world titles (2015, 2016).

songs.crowd_reaction: Deafening crowd chants of 'Let's Go Bunting Mental!' chanted repeatedly over the electronic synth chords.
songs.walk_on_history: Sparked a viral TikTok and arena movement in 2024 that turned Bunting into the ultimate people's champion.

songs.crowd_reaction: Regarded as one of the single greatest crowd singalongs in world sport, with entire arenas screaming the lyrics word-for-word.
songs.walk_on_history: Selected in 2019 and became the defining soundtrack to his World Matchplay and UK Open victories.

songs.crowd_reaction: Vibrant party tune triggering carnival vibes and synchronized arm swaying throughout the hall.
songs.walk_on_history: Carried Cross from electrical tradesman to World Champion during his 2018 debut triumph.

songs.crowd_reaction: Drums matched by the iconic 'Barney Army! Barney Army!' chorus chanted by fans dressed in vibrant orange.
songs.walk_on_history: A legendary entrance track that has accompanied Barney across three decades and five World Championship titles.

songs.crowd_reaction: Upbeat pop singalong with pink cowboy hats waving and fans chanting 'There's only one Fallon Sherrock!'
songs.walk_on_history: Soundtrack to the historic night in December 2019 when she became the first woman to win a World Championship match.

songs.crowd_reaction: Infectious retro disco rhythm prompting spontaneous dancing, singing, and table clapping.
songs.walk_on_history: Adopted during her historic record-shattering dominance on the PDC Women's Series and WDF World Championships.
